name: readable-helper-urls
goal: Readable helper paths retain callable identity, branch, revision, tabs and backward-compatible deep links

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Replace module-id and query helper links with readable helper-name paths and path tabs; qualify duplicate names, preserve branch/commit and old links.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing route roundtrip and callable-detail matrices require query selectors and never assert readable addresses, alias ambiguity or direct refresh. Strengthen those shared cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 32ef6466 fails Readable helper paths in committed route tests. The unchanged desktop browser matrix separately fails because it retains module ids and helper/tab query selectors; before captures saved.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 846b2a93 adds helper-name paths, optional owner qualification, revision-bound resolution, legacy redirects and explicit unknown-name states. Standard desktop/tablet/mobile browser matrix passes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 846b2a93 passes the identical frozen command and environment paired with failing 1fc95d66: 74 root route/legacy/canonical tests and ten revision-resolution tests.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
